PUBLISHED PYTHON DEVELOPER TOOL

RepoLens

The problem

Repository quality signals are scattered across tools and files. I wanted one repeatable assessment with findings tied to evidence.

What I built

A Python CLI with separate acquisition, typed analyzers, orchestration, scoring and reporting. It produces console, JSON and standalone HTML output.

A key decision

Analyze target source statically rather than importing it or running its tests. Explicit availability states keep incomplete analysis from appearing clean.

The result

Published release 0.1.1 on PyPI, with cross-platform CI and automated release publishing. The release verification records 1,200+ tests and approximately 99.6% own coverage.

Status: Published Python-first static analyzer. Its score is an assessment of supported static signals, not a security certification.

Python · AST · pytest · Ruff · mypy · GitHub Actions

OFFLINE RETAIL APPLICATION

Vendiqo

The problem

Retail workflows need to keep inventory, customer dues and money movements consistent without depending on connectivity.

What I built

A Windows application covering purchases, sales, credit/collections, referenced returns, reservations, supplier payments and gross-profit reporting.

A key decision

Keep transactional operations and an immutable inventory movement ledger behind the UI. Validate backups before replacing the database and retain a rollback copy.

The result

Implemented the workflows with automated regression checks and a repeatable Windows build and installer process.

Status: Windows release candidate; private source. Code signing and final target-machine/printer acceptance remain release tasks.

Python · Qt · SQLAlchemy · SQLite

MOBILE MESSAGING / PUBLIC SOURCE

Loopnest

The problem

Private conversations need explicit rules for invitations, access, media lifecycle and account removal.

What I built

A rebuilt React Native/Supabase app with accepted invitations, Realtime text, private photo sharing, one-time viewing, blocking and account deletion. The earlier Java/Firebase internship app is a separate archived implementation.

A key decision

Enforce participant and media access in the backend, with tested database policies and deletion ordering. Describe access-controlled chats accurately rather than imply end-to-end encryption.

The result

Core workflows have Android/iOS device-testing records, alongside automated authorization and real backend integration checks.

Status: Active development; access-controlled, not end-to-end encrypted. Native scroll/keyboard retesting, expiry/capture checks and signed-build acceptance remain open.

TypeScript · Expo · React Native · Supabase · PostgreSQL

LIVE OFFLINE WEB APPLICATION

InternLog PK

The problem

Students need a clear record of genuine internship activities and working hours without surrendering their records to a server.

What I built

An installable web logbook with exact time totals, weekly reports, IndexedDB storage, offline caching and reviewed backup replacement.

A key decision

Use revision-checked writes and atomic dataset replacement. Preserve drafts and records on conflicts or failed writes instead of silently overwriting them.

The result

Deployed publicly, with cross-browser workflow tests and Android testing covering offline use, recovery, PDF output and a TalkBack walkthrough.

Status: Deployed release candidate. Records are self-reported; student field validation and broader physical-device acceptance are still separate work.

React · TypeScript · IndexedDB · Service Workers · Playwright

FULL-STACK DISCOVERY APPLICATION

Cineyra

The problem

Choosing a film requires combining lasting taste with the constraints of a particular evening.

What I built

A React/TypeScript application with accounts, saved libraries, recommendation history, export and account deletion. Supabase functions combine deterministic matching with optional OpenRouter reasoning.

A key decision

Keep hard filters and account ownership explicit. Reconcile preference evidence transactionally when ratings or notes change, and isolate per-account cached state.

The result

Core flows have live QA records and synthetic browser regressions across desktop/mobile Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

Status: Private MVP. Automated services are mocked in browser regressions; wider product evaluation and public release are future work.

React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Supabase · Vitest · Playwright

RELEASED DEVELOPER TOOL / GITHUB ALPHA

SurfaceDiff

The problem

Changes to a model or prompt can alter a generated interface’s structure. I wanted a repeatable way to detect those changes against a reviewed baseline.

What I built

An offline Python CLI that validates captured A2UI messages, replays surface and data updates, writes canonical snapshots and compares them against an approved baseline. Human-readable and JSON reports make structural changes usable in local review and CI.

A key decision

Keep structural comparison separate from rendering or model execution. Preserve approved baselines, reject incomplete inputs and use distinct exit codes for equality, differences and failed analysis.

The result

Completed the engineering phases and published v1.0.0 on GitHub with a wheel, source archive and checksums. Windows/Linux CI on Python 3.12/3.13 verifies tests, typing, artifact installation and repeat-build checks.

Status: GitHub alpha/pre-release; no PyPI distribution. Independent, unofficial A2UI tooling supporting the documented pinned schema/catalog scope.

Python · JSON Schema · pytest · mypy · GitHub Actions
